2017-67.in_force_basis: Latest amending law in the complete 2017 Title 67 histories: Chapter 220, Laws of 2015 (HB 99), approved April 10, 2015. The official effective-date table gives 10/01/2015 (2015 Session Laws volume II, PDF p. 1224); the complete act has no separate commencement clause (volume I, PDF pp. 955-983), consistent with MCA 1-2-201(1)(a).
2017-67.note: Official 2017 edition of Title 67; its latest cited amendment is Chapter 220, Laws of 2015. This is an earlier consolidated text, dated by that amendment's effective day, not a claim to the original enactment.

2019-67.in_force_basis: Chapter 455, Laws of 2019 (HB 661), section 16: [This act] is effective July 1, 2019. Approved May 10, 2019. Official 2019 Session Laws volume II, PDF p. 736; this is the latest amending law in the complete 2019 Title 67 section histories.
2019-67.note: Official 2019 edition of Title 67, dated by Chapter 455's express July 1, 2019 commencement. The six sections added or changed since the 2017 edition all cite that chapter.
